intro.paragraph1: Every shipment has a different story and purpose. To us, Cargo is not just about moving goods from one place to another, but about safeguarding the trust that every customer places in us.
intro.paragraph2: Lion Cargo Logistik is an official air cargo forwarding service provider offering port-to-port air cargo, with operations directly connected through the Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Cargo Terminal (CGK) to support shipments to various destination cities across Indonesia.

friendship.title: Serving and Building Genuine Relationships <red>Like True Friends</red>
friendship.paragraph1: In the fast-paced freight forwarding industry, we understand that your cargo is not just a parcel measured in kilograms, but a business commitment, a company reputation, and a promise that must arrive on time.
friendship.paragraph2: That is why Lion Cargo Logistik never positions itself as just another forwarding vendor. We are a strategic partner who listens, understands the dynamics of your shipping needs, and delivers the best solutions through a transparent, family-like approach.
friendship.paragraph3: From coordination at the reception gate of the Soekarno-Hatta Cargo Terminal (CGK) and handling Air Waybill (SMU) documents, to confirming that your cargo has arrived at the destination airport, our team is ready to accompany every step of your shipment, responsively, like a friend you can always rely on.

showcase.title: Understanding Every <red>Character of Your Shipment</red>
showcase.paragraph1: Behind every cargo load, from small-business production boxes and inter-island garment supplies to vital spare parts and valuable documents, lies a story of hard work and trust that you entrust to us.
showcase.paragraph2: Our operations team at the Soekarno-Hatta Airport Cargo, Tangerang is here to ensure that whatever the form and needs of your cargo, the treatment we give remains the same: full of responsibility, careful, and highly dedicated.
showcase.imageAlt: The Range of Cargo Entrusted to Us - Lion Cargo Logistik

closing.title: Ready to Ship Your Cargo <red>Without Hesitation</red>
closing.description: Every stage of air cargo shipping from the Soekarno-Hatta Airport Cargo Terminal, Tangerang is managed transparently, safely, and professionally to ensure your parcels and goods arrive on time at the destination city.
